messages:
Marie CSM: Quick heads-up — prepping the wellness handoff for Vireo (early-adopter). Check-in scheduled next Wed 10:00am PT. Need: final attendee list, updated enablement deck, recording to share, and a 3-question post-demo survey. Renewal risk currently LOW but flagged for connector latency. Assigning owners: @Raj PM (connector follow-up), @Claire SE (enablement + office hours), @Evan EngOps (telemetry/infra notes). Can folks confirm? :wave:

Raj PM: Ack. I'll reproduce the latency spike with the Vireo dataset today and loop in infra if it's repro-able. Will update runbook if we need a hotfix.

Claire SE: Got it — I'll publish deck v2 to the shared folder and schedule two 30m office hours next Tues/Thurs for their engineers. I'll add suggested prompt templates.

Evan EngOps: Noted. I'll validate the telemetry for their region and add a note about fallback routing. If connector is intermittent we can enable caching config for them.

OnboardBot: Checklist update: `invite_sent=true`, `deck_v2_uploaded=false` -> updating to `true`, `recording_requested=true`. Tickets created: CS-3421, ENG-7583.

Marie CSM: Thanks — @Claire SE can you drop the deck link here once uploaded? Also want a one-liner we can include in the invite: subject + 2 bullet talking points.

Claire SE: Sure. Draft subject: "Redwood: Vireo early-adopter onboarding — 30m". Bullets: "1) Quick product tour + integration checklist; 2) Q&A + connector troubleshooting" Will paste deck link in a bit. :thumbsup:

Raj PM: Quick note — if I can't repro locally I'll ask their SRE to run the capture we requested. Saving us a meeting cycle. Also adding a column in the runbook for TTL/cache settings. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vireo-connector (internal)

Evan EngOps: On infra side I'll check GPU/IO metrics for the period they saw the spike (2026-03-10 14:00 UTC). If we need a temporary capacity bump for the demo we can provision burst capacity for the slot.

Marie CSM: Action items summary for next steps:
- Claire: upload deck + post recording after demo (due Tue EOD)
- Raj: connector repro & runbook updates (due Mon)
- Evan: telemetry check + plan for temporary bump if needed (due Mon)
- Marie: create 3-question survey and NPS baseline, send final invite (due Tue)
Please reply with any conflicts. I'll keep the customer-facing invite language short.

Claire SE: No conflicts. Adding deck link: https://storage.redwood.com/enables/vireo-deck-v2.pdf

Raj PM: If anyone wants to review the repro steps: ```steps:
1) ingest sample vireo dataset (~2GB)
2) run connector with `--batch-size=128 --timeout=45s`
3) monitor `connector.latency.p90`
```

OnboardBot: Reminder: meeting created for 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC (10:00am PT). Calendar invites sent to attendees.

Marie CSM: Great — final ask: after the demo please capture 2 quick quotes on ease-of-use and one improvement request. We'll include in the beta feedback rollup. Thanks team! :pray:
